# QS-CFW-1931-62 - Quality specification - gear blank CFW-1931-62 (8620)

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P3  
Parts: CFW-1931-62

## Scope
This quality specification applies to the manufacture, inspection, and disposition of gear blank CFW-1931-62 (CFW-1931-62) forged from alloy 8620 at Plant P3. It defines acceptance requirements for critical features, inspection methods to be used, and nonconformance handling procedures.

## Requirements table
| Feature | Requirement | Acceptance |
|---|---|---|
| Material identification | Alloy per part print | Conform |
| Hardness range | The hardness range for gear blank CFW-1931-62 (CFW-1931-62) is 38-41 HRC. | Within range |
| Bore diameter tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for gear blank CFW-1931-62 (CFW-1931-62) is ±0.08 mm. | Within tolerance |
| Maximum forging weight | The maximum forging weight for gear blank CFW-1931-62 (CFW-1931-62) is 97.9 kg. | Below or equal |

## Inspection method
Visual inspection to verify surface condition and material traceability. Dimensional inspection of bore diameter to be performed using calibrated metrology equipment capable of reading to the required tolerance. Hardness testing to be performed on the specified locations using a calibrated hardness tester appropriate for HRC scale; report actual readings and verify that readings meet the hardness range specified. Record inspection results on the part inspection record and attach to the travel document.

Calibration records for measurement devices used must be available at time of inspection. Any inspection requiring confirmation beyond in-plant capability shall be routed to approved external laboratory with documented methods. Retain inspection records in the document control system as part of the lot record.

## Nonconformance handling
Parts failing to meet any requirement in the Requirements table shall be segregated and tagged as nonconforming. Initiate a nonconformance report and disposition per plant procedures. Disposition options include rework if the nonconformance is correctable without affecting integrity, use-as-is only with documented engineering approval, or scrap. Return to forging only after root cause is addressed and corrective actions are verified.
